transcript: When your back hurts, it is a sign the energy along your spine has stopped moving. In Chinese healing, we never wait. We open the river again with simple daily movements. Let me teach you three exercises my teacher made me practice every morning. One. Opening the gate. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Raise both hands above your head. Interlock your fingers. And stretch upward as if pushing the sky. Hold for 10 seconds. This opens the spine and releases pressure in the lower back. Two. Swinging arms. Relax your shoulders and let your arms hang like soft ropes. Gently twist left and right. Letting your arms tap your lower back. Do this for one to two minutes. This loosens the waist and awakens circulation around the spine. Three. Cat breathing. Go onto your hands and knees. Inhale as you drop your belly and lift your head. Exhale as you round your back like a cat. Repeat 20 slow waves. Do these each morning and your back will feel lighter day by day. And if you want deeper healing for the body and mind, I placed a simple healing e-book in the link on my profile. Start tonight.
